texts.name: rank_casual_driver_description
texts.devText: The Casual Driver is a laid-back traveler, enjoying his journey while focusing on getting to their destination in a timely manner

texts.name: rank_comfortable_navigator_description
texts.devText: A Comfortable Navigator is a driver who ensures passengers are at ease throughout the ride.

texts.name: rank_attentive_chauffeur_description
texts.devText: The Attentive Chauffeur is a diligent and safety-conscious driver. Their commitment to safety makes them a reliable choice for any trip.

texts.name: rank_green_roller_description
texts.devText: The Green Roller is a driver with a gentle touch on the wheel, skillfully navigating the road with a focus on precision and safety.

texts.name: rank_cool_cruiser_description
texts.devText: Cool Cruisers bring a sense of style to the road. They handle their vehicle with grace and finesse, making driving look effortless.

texts.name: rank_smooth_operator_description
texts.devText: A Smooth Operator is the master of a fluid and seamless driving experience, ensuring a smooth and comfortable ride for all.

texts.name: rank_road_champion_description
texts.devText: The Road Champion is the pinnacle of driving excellence. They conquer the road with unwavering skill and precision.

texts.name: challenge_comfortable_joe_description
texts.devText: Drive without hard breaking or hard acceleration for 45 minutes

texts.name: challenge_good_effort_description
texts.devText: Complete 40 trips with a score above 80 regardless of the trip duration

texts.name: challenge_consistency_king_description
texts.devText: Score above 90 for the past 10 trips of at least 10 minutes

texts.name: challenge_braking_bad_habits_description
texts.devText: No hard braking events until two consecutive trips of at least 15 minutes each have been completed

texts.name: challenge_gentle_glide_description
texts.devText: Complete a 30-minute trip with no more than one event, which can not be severe

texts.name: challenge_rock_steady_description
texts.devText: Drive without any harsh cornering events for 60 minutes

texts.name: locationPermissionScreen_explanation
texts.devText:
The My Driving Style App requires access to your device's GPS to accurately analyze your driving behavior and to provide key features such as challenges, driver analytics, and other gamification elements. This data is essential for ensuring the app functions as intended. Without location permission, these features cannot be enabled, and the app will not be usable.

To proceed, please grant the permission by following the click path:

Open Settings > Permissions > Location > Allow all the time > Return to App

texts.name: notificationPermissionScreen_explanation
texts.devText:
The My Driving Style App requires permission to notifications in order to keep you informed about important updates, relevant changes, and exclusive offerings. Enabling notifications ensures that the My Driving Style App works as intended and that you don’t miss out on key information related to your driving analytics and app features. Without this permission, you may not receive essential alerts.

To proceed, please grant the permission by following the click path:

Grant Permission > Allow

texts.name: notificationPermissionScreen_explanation2
texts.devText:
The My Driving Style App requires permission to notifications in order to keep you informed about important updates, relevant changes, and exclusive offerings. To proceed, please grant the permission by following the click path:

texts.name: challenge_minimalist_description
texts.devText: Complete at least 10 trips in 1 week with maximum 1 driving event

texts.name: challenge_minimalist_info
texts.devText: Complete at least 10 trips within 1 week while keeping your total driving events to no more than 1. Enjoy a near-flawless week of smooth driving!

texts.name: challenge_rising_star_description
texts.devText: Improve or equal your trip score 3/5/8 times in a row.

texts.name: challenge_rising_star_info
texts.devText: Improve or match your previous trip score 3/5/8 times consecutively. Each qualifying trip must be at least 1 km long.

texts.name: challenge_city_smooth_operator_description
texts.devText: Drive under 60 km/h with zero hard acceleration for 30/60/90 minutes!

texts.name: challenge_city_smooth_operator_info
texts.devText: Maintain a smooth streak driving below 60 km/h with zero hard acceleration for 30/60/90 minutes depending on your level. Stay focused!

texts.name: challenge_highway_star_description
texts.devText: Drive above 80 km/h with zero events for 30/60/90 min.

texts.name: challenge_highway_star_info
texts.devText: Build a smooth driving streak above 80 km/h lasting 30/60/90 minutes total per level. Any driving event resets your streak within a minute.

texts.name: challenge_night_owl_description
texts.devText: Complete 3 night trips of 20+ min with a score of 80/90/100.

texts.name: challenge_night_owl_info
texts.devText: Complete 3 nighttime trips between 22:00 and 05:00 lasting at least 20 minutes each. Meet score requirements of 80/90/100.

texts.name: challenge_long_hauler_description
texts.devText: Complete 2 trips of at least 60/90/120 minutes each with a score above 90.

texts.name: challenge_long_hauler_info
texts.devText: Complete 2 extended trips lasting 60/90/120 minutes each with a driving score above 90. Maintain steady focus throughout!

texts.name: challenge_early_bird_description
texts.devText: Complete 5/7/10 consecutive morning trips (05:00-10:00) with score 80/90/100.

texts.name: challenge_early_bird_info
texts.devText: Complete 5/7/10 consecutive morning trips between 05:00 and 10:00, with each trip achieving a score of 80/90/100. Drive safely!

texts.name: challenge_early_bird_champion_description
texts.devText: Complete 3/5/7 consecutive morning trips with a score of 95+.

texts.name: challenge_early_bird_champion_info
texts.devText: Complete 3/5/7 morning trips in a row between 05:00 and 10:00, with each trip achieving a high score of at least 95.

texts.name: challenge_clean_sheet_description
texts.devText: Complete 3/5/7 flawless trips with a score of 100 in a single day.

texts.name: challenge_clean_sheet_info
texts.devText: Complete 3/5/7 flawless trips in one day with a perfect driving score of 100 for each trip. Achieve ultimate precision!

texts.name: challenge_delivery_hero_description
texts.devText: Complete 5/7/10 short trips with a driving score of 80 or more in a single day.

texts.name: challenge_delivery_hero_info
texts.devText: Complete 5/7/10 short trips (up to 5 km or 5 minutes) with a driving score of 80 or higher in a single day.

texts.name: challenge_rush_hour_hero_description
texts.devText: Complete 6 rush hour trips with a score of 80/90/100.

texts.name: challenge_rush_hour_hero_info
texts.devText: Complete 6 rush-hour trips (3 morning and 3 afternoon between 06:30-09:00 or 16:00-18:30) with score targets of 80/90/100.

texts.name: challenge_school_bus_description
texts.devText: Complete 10 clean trips with no harsh braking or acceleration!

texts.name: challenge_school_bus_info
texts.devText: Drive safely through September without any harsh braking or acceleration events. Complete 10 clean trips to finish the challenge.

texts.name: challenge_straight_a_driver_description
texts.devText: Maintain a score of 85 or higher for 5 trips in a row!

texts.name: challenge_straight_a_driver_info
texts.devText: Achieve 5 consecutive trips with a score of 85 or more. One low score will reset your active streak, so stay focused on every single trip!

texts.name: challenge_top_of_the_class_description
texts.devText: Reach a high monthly score of 95 or more!

texts.name: challenge_top_of_the_class_info
texts.devText: Drive with great care all month long. Your goal is to achieve an overall monthly driving score of at least 95 for September.

texts.name: challenge_perfect_attendance_description
texts.devText: Score 80 or higher on every school day!

texts.name: challenge_perfect_attendance_info
texts.devText: Complete at least one good trip with a score of 80 or above every single school day. One qualifying trip per day is all you need!

texts.name: challenge_santas_co_pilot_description
texts.devText: Zero severe events from Dec 20 to 26!

texts.name: challenge_santas_co_pilot_info
texts.devText: Complete holiday trips from December 20 to 26 without any severe driving events. Stay safe and enjoy your festive travels!

texts.name: challenge_fresh_start_description
texts.devText: Improve your monthly driving score or reach 80!

texts.name: challenge_fresh_start_info
texts.devText: Start the year right by improving your score compared to last month. New drivers need to reach a monthly score above 80.

texts.name: challenge_weekend_vibe_info
texts.devText: Complete 2/4/6 clean trips without any bad driving events over the weekend. Only event-free trips count toward your goal, so relax and take it easy!

texts.name: challenge_delivery_champion_description
texts.devText: Complete 25/35/50 weekly trips with a score of 80+.

texts.name: challenge_delivery_champion_info
texts.devText: Complete 25/35/50 trips with a score of 80 or higher during week. Lower scores do not fail your challenge.

texts.name: challenge_delivery_legend_description
texts.devText: Finish 100/150/200 trips with an 80+ score during month.

texts.name: challenge_delivery_legend_info
texts.devText: Complete 100/150/200 trips this month with a score of 80 or more. Trips below the threshold simply do not count.

texts.devText: No challenges yet. Start your first challenge from the ‘All’ or ‘Recommended’ tab

texts.name: challenges_no_trophies_available
texts.devText: Complete a few starter challenges in All tab to earn your first trophies and access exclusive seasonal challenges with higher rewards.
